decisions.reason: It builds directly on the firm's established spraying expertise, and with strong in-house R&D and research links the firm is well placed to refine a niche system that remained on the website through 2024.

This pump is close to the core offer, had its own page in both years, and the field-test reference suggests the firm has enough related knowledge to learn from deployment and continue commercialization.
The product explicitly reuses the firm's proven air-motor technology, making it highly related to existing knowledge and therefore very likely to be retained and improved rather than withdrawn.

Although flow monitoring adds a stronger monitoring component than the firm's classic equipment lines, it still builds on the installed base and fits the strategic move toward more digitalized solutions, so retention is more likely than exit.

As the newest launch it carries the most short-term uncertainty, but because it is close to the established two-component spraying business and the firm has strong absorptive capacity, management would likely keep it on the market for further learning.
